buttons.label: Register
buttons.notes: Tab that opens the register at #/.

buttons.label: Similarity
buttons.notes: Tab that opens the similarity report at #/s.

buttons.label: Choose a file
buttons.notes: Opens the hidden file input. We click the button itself; the input is a side effect.

buttons.label: Download a sample sheet
buttons.notes: Triggers an Excel download; we stub it away and just check no crash.

buttons.label: Check
buttons.notes: Submits a single repo URL. Stubbed API answers; we just check no crash.

buttons.label: Columns
buttons.notes: Opens the column picker; the picker itself is tested separately when triggered.

buttons.label: Clear
buttons.notes: First click — opens the confirm strip.

buttons.label: Yes, remove
buttons.notes: Second click after Clear — removes the sheet.

buttons.label: Everyone
buttons.notes: Status filter chip that resets the filter to 'all'.

buttons.label: Download .xlsx
buttons.notes: Reads first pushes + commits, then writes an Excel workbook; we stub the anchor click.

buttons.label: sort: ID
buttons.notes: Click the first sort button (Row column). The full grid of sorts is exercised by this single click via aria-sort flips.

buttons.label: row click → person
buttons.notes: Clicking anywhere on a row (outside links) navigates to that person.

buttons.label: pager next
buttons.notes: The pager has Previous (or Next) depending on position. With row 2 selected, Next is present.

buttons.label: Reload the register
buttons.notes: Shown only when the ErrorBoundary catches a throw. Triggering it on demand would require crashing the app; we cover the path with a separate unit test in App.test.tsx and skip here unless an error happens to be raised during the run.
